name: Nurse Nutrition Facts 20 oz Tumbler
seoTitle: Nurse Nutrition Facts Tumbler Gift 20 oz
metaDescription: A 20 oz tumbler printed with a funny nurse nutrition facts label. A cheerful gift for new nurses, nursing students, and NPs who need coffee all shift.
summary: A funny nutrition facts label for nurses on a 20 oz tumbler, a cheerful pick for graduations, Nurses Week, or any nurse who refills their coffee all shift.
whyItWorks: Nurses joke that their bodies run on coffee, stubbornness, and whatever snacks are left in the break room. A tumbler with a mock nutrition facts label plays on that idea and gives the recipient something to smile at every time they pick it up during a long shift.

The 20 ounce size suits how nurses actually drink. Breaks are short and unpredictable, so a larger cup that can be filled once at the start of a 12 hour shift and sipped through the morning is more useful than a small mug. Tumblers also travel well between the car, the break room, and the nurses station. Since the title calls out students, new nurses, and nurse practitioners, it works across a wide range of careers, from someone just starting clinicals to an NP years into practice. For a graduation gift, fill it with a bag of good coffee or a few gift cards to their favorite drive through.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether it is insulated and how well the lid seals before relying on it in a work bag.
Read the listing photos closely to see the exact wording on the label.
Confirm the care instructions, since printed tumblers often recommend hand washing.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse practitioner?
faq.a: Yes, the nurse humor fits NPs too, and the title lists them as a recipient. It is a fun desk or clinic cup.

faq.q: Will this fit in a car cup holder?
faq.a: Many 20 oz tumblers do, but check the listing for dimensions before buying if that matters to the recipient.
